views.markdown: Apple Music, iOS 26 style. A small glass now-playing pill (swipe to skip, scrolling title) that collapses with the tab bar, iOS 26 album, artist, search and library pages, star favorites, glass top buttons, animated album covers in the player and more. For iOS 15 and 16, every iPhone (A11 and newer). Tested on iPhone 13 Pro Max, iOS 16. Made by nano.
Landscape: gone when you go Home (no stuck view), Insights hides AirPlay / Insights buttons, even volume row, "Big Cover With Lyrics" (tap cover = play / pause, swipe = change song)
Landscape: animated icons, reactive volume icons, lyrics centered, volume row centered, AirPlay up top, small volume knob
No ... in Insights; hold to peek wins over Music opening the player; splash: comfortable size, follows the pill when it minimizes / expands, tap opens the player
Hold the pill to peek (cover, live lyric line, time), song change splash (switch), share card + Music's menu in Insights
Dynamic Pill closing redone: top comes down first, sides pull in with a tiny squish, pull it down with your finger
Closing the Dynamic Pill uses a fresh picture of the pill (art and text no longer drop into place after)
The pill is never hidden under the Dynamic Pill (no half-second jump after closing)
Dynamic Pill opens from where the pill is under your finger, contents in at once, one quick spring; closes in one spring and lands with no fade
Release (Dynamic Pill, landscape player with lyrics, new settings, new icon)
Island always starts and lands exactly on the pill (one spring, no stretched picture); settings page redone with a header and a Dynamic Pill demo
Tap outside the island closes it (crashed before), smaller swipe stretch
Swipe jelly and touch light now play on the pill you see (they played on Music's invisible bar under it)
Island closes smoothly back to the pill, scrolling Insights no longer shrinks the pill, Sleep Timer morphs out of the island

Pill no longer grows after landscape; landscape uses plain icons, timed lyrics on the right with controls kept, top buttons hide with Insights; swipe up grows the pill into Insights like the Dynamic Island
Landscape v2 - Music really turns (home bar along the bottom, no status bar), lyrics button, glass control capsule, normal AirPlay icon, still background with Increase Contrast
Landscape player (turn the phone: cover left, glass controls right, colors from the cover, Insights in two columns), smaller pill on Library
Jelly bounce after a swipe always shows (flicks on a skip, wobbles home); no second star after lyrics / queue
Menu grows from the pill with the glass filling in and melts back into it, glass touch light on the pill, pill 4.5pt lower, Up Next row removed
Menus grow out of the pill and go back into it; the 3s wait after closing the player is gone
The pill follows your finger (sideways = skip with jelly, up = glass menu), hold = Music's song menu, tap opens the player (no swipe up), new Insights, live waveform
Hold the Pill (glass menu: Up Next, Sleep Timer, Music Insights), Waveform on the cover, jelly bounce on the pill swipe
The artist page's own About and its gray background are left as they are; the "i" About sheet stays
Stopped moving the artist page's sections by hand (broke the header); the old About is collapsed through the page's own layout instead
The old About stays gone (also when Music swaps its views) and the page end no longer jumps; the About sheet keeps the artist name
The old About no longer flickers back while scrolling (re-hidden right after Music lays out the page); no gray panel behind Similar Artists
About works on Music's stacked artist page (sections in one scroll view): reads About / From / Born / Genre, hides that section and pulls Similar Artists up
About reads the artist page's main list (it was reading a small list inside the header)
About reading also tries spoken labels and text layers; more debug
About sheet finds the artist page's list another way (it wasn't found before)
About sheet reads Music's text better and finds the header photo inside layers; keeps checking the page so the bottom About is removed
